_comment: Magical Door plan Task D4 (issue #8): door_awakening's start (FIXTURE-FIRST -- beats 1-3 are already covered live by door_chain_fight/talk/scout, so this canonical starts PAST all of them, beat-3-ready). Classless on purpose (no `classes` entry at all) so sleep()'s class_gains/level_ups/consolidation/evolution branches are all guaranteed no-ops for the whole run -- the ONLY thing that can happen at any of the three sleeps this script drives is the D4 study hook itself, keeping every ui_sleep_veil_rendered{lines} assertion unambiguous. All three of D3's beat-3 counters are pre-banked (door_understood, recovered_anchor_stone, bought_catalyst) alongside door_chain_started (the chain's own start-of-consult flag) and post_game (harmlessly inert here, matching the door_chain_talk_start precedent's convention of a quiet epilogue-suppressed state). Standing at (2,6) facing down, one cell north of the ground-floor `bed` (2,7) -- interact triggers sleep() directly, no traversal needed.
